name: Apex Solventless Live Rosin Tier S | Yellowtail (73-119u)
description: The iconic citrus lemon terps of Lemontree team up with the ever so delicious candy Z of Blue Zushi to create a unique terp experience! Yellowtail #4 gives off inital scents of lemon, candy, and funk that sting nostrils and prepare your body for the treat to come! The taste of Yellowtail is akin to a yellow gummy fish, with notes of dank lemony salmon hitting from the background. Her rosin finishes creamy, and provides a unique way to relax from your day with the gummy fish lemon zest held within. The iconic terpene expressesion combined with the unique new profile, earns Yellowtial her spot on the S-Tier menu.
